page_transcriptions.text: Institute of International Cooperation and Education (IICE). UOS Partner Information.
University of Seoul (UOS). University of Seoul, Institute of International Cooperation and Education. 163 Seoulsiripdae-ro, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea 02504.

Academic Year 2023. Spring Semester, 2023: Orientation February 28, 2023; Classes begin March 2, 2023; Classes end June 21, 2023; Nomination Deadline October 15, 2022; Application Deadline October 31, 2022. Fall Semester, 2023: Orientation August 31, 2023; Classes begin September 1, 2023; Classes end December 21, 2023; Nomination Deadline April 15, 2023; Application Deadline April 30, 2023. Tuition is paid to the home university, and in most cases, the application and documentation fee is waived.

Nominated students are required to complete UOS online application. What to submit on arrival: (1) One official photo (3.5cm x 4.5cm, full color with white background) for alien registration. (2) Certificate of Health, TB test result (or Chest X-ray) (it is a mandatory document only for on-campus housing residents and required to submit to housing office at check-in). Mostly Korean, but some of classes lectured in English. We cannot guarantee the courses your students would like to take. Language requirements (i.e.TOEFL scores): N/A. Applicants should have good commend of either Korean or English.

Undergraduate students should have completed at least two terms of university studies. All the courses offered at graduate level are taught in Korean. For the graduate students who are not fluent in Korean is strongly advised to be enrolled to undergraduate program. In this case, the student should ask his/her study abroad coordinator at the home university if this option would be accepted according to the university's policy. Recommended credit points per semester: 15 credits. A student should take at least 6 credits and can take up to 20 credits.

D-2 visa holders are automatically included in the mandatory National Health Insurance program. All international students are required to pay the Health Insurance Fee for Int'l Students every month from alien registration date. ex) Monthly contributions for international students for 2022: 56,030KRW. The Certificate of Health is required to be submitted to on-campus housing office for those who stay on-campus housing.

UOS only secure/guarantee on-campus housing only for those exchange students whose universities secure/guarantee on-campus housing for UOS students. UOS do not secure on-campus housing to all partner universities for dormitory room shortage. Please confirm with your home university coordinator your housing option before complete UOS online application. Residence Hall: Each room of double occupancy. Fees: 636,000KRW/semester + 100,000KRW deposit = 736,000KRW. Fees for vacation (about 2 months): 435,000 KRW.

International House: Each unit with 2 rooms / 3 rooms / 5 rooms of single occupancy. Fees: 912,000KRW/semester + 100,000KRW deposit = 1,012,000KRW. Fees for vacation (about 2 months): 435,000KRW fee. Curfew between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. Fees are payable on arrival at UOS. Above information is subject to change. Off-campus housing is a contractual matter between students and accommodation, and the UOS IICE is not involved at all.

Scholarship can be offered on condition that your home university provides similar benefits for UOS students in return. If yes, how much is it? (200,000 KRW to 400,000 KRW per month). The recipients should stay in Korea more than 15 days per month to receive this scholarship. UOS scholarship is not provided during vacations (July&August / January&February).

Estimated costs: 800,000 KRW - 1,000,000 KRW per month. Including food, local transportation, books, entertainment, etc. Exchange students will hear from SeoulMate by email about a month before each semester starts. UOS's location in Seoul: 10km away from City Hall (North East Seoul). Above information is subject to change.
UOS Partner Information. Institute of International Cooperation and Education IICE.

Student Exchange Program

UOS Partner Information

Exchange students are those who have applied and are nominated by an overseas university
under a formal exchange agreement. Exchange student candidates can apply through the
international office of their home university. Tuition is paid to the home university, and in

most cases, the application and documentation fee

is waived. Students from UOS partner

universities can apply for the UOS student exchange program. Applications should proceed
with the approval of the international office of the students' home university.

Accommodation

3-1. On Campus Housing: Residence Hall & International House

- UOS only secure/guarantee on-campus housing only for those exchange students
whose universities secure/guarantee on-campus housing for UOS students.

IMPORTANT - ISEP students are assigned to stay on-campus housing (only in Residence Hall)

NOTES - UOS do not secure on-campus housing to all partner universities for dormitory room
shortage. Please confirm with your home university coordinator your housing option
before complete UOS online application.

Room Type of
Residence Hall

Each room of double occupancy, 15 rooms on each of the 7 floors

- Shower room, Toilet, and Laundry are shared.

- Extension possible during vacations.

* Fees : 636,000KRW/semester + 100,000KRW deposit = 736,000KRW
* Fees for vacation (about 2 months) : 435,000 KRW

* Application for vacation: right before each semester ends

Institute of International Cooperation and Education(IICE)
UOS Partner Information

Room Type of
International House

Each unit with 2 rooms /3 rooms / 5 rooms of single occupancy

- Living room, Shower room, Toilet, and Laundry are shared.

- Extension possible during vacations,

Fees : 912,000KRW/semester + 100,000KRW deposit = 1,012,000KRW
* Fees for vacation (about 2 months): 435,000KRW fee

* Application for vacation: right before each semester ends

Remarks

In both housings, male and female sections are segregated.

Allocation will be done on random basis.

Curfew between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.

Fees are payable on arrival at UOS.

Deposit will be refunded after the fees for usage of facilities are deducted.

How to apply

You will have applied it through the UOS on-line application system.

Above information is subject to change.

3-2. Off-campus Housing

Several Options
Recommended

UOS introduce several off-campus accommodations near UOS campus or in downtown.
The list of available housing can be different every semester.

NOTE: Off-campus housing is a contractual matter between students and
accommodation, and the UOS IICE is not involved at all. Please review the terms and
conditions of the accommodation contract carefully before you sign the contract.
